The driver with no shock against Network.run() on the same configurations: 0 differ. A30's recorded rows recomputed through this driver: 360 rows, 0 fields differ. In every cell the claim total equals held plus parked at every yield, to 1e-09 of the opening stock: 3850 of 3850. Every freeze comes back node for node: 1050 of 1050. Every shocked cell's generators end where its twin's end: 2800 of 2800. The round loop's own asserts, the withdrawal's among them, did not fire: all 3850 cells completed. Gate verdict: pass. State map: the module with the switch off identical to the module before it, the driver with no shock identical to Network.run(), A30's rows reproduced, and the three checks above holding -> PASS; anything else -> FAIL; no gate section -> not judged, and --run does not start.

criteria.detail: Every round, in the loop: what leaves held plus parked equals what was taken, no account is taken below zero, and what the cap leaves uncollected is recorded and not carried. criteria.detail: Printed, not judged. Each two-sided twin against the one-sided twin on the same carrier and seed, at the close. Block states: block under = 50 or more nodes more below the floor than the reference at the close; block lifted = 50 or more fewer; no block = everything else, printed as A30-3's own six states beside it. Reading per carrier and gain: position decides = the three positions do not all leave the same block state; the aggregate decides = all three leave the same block state, so on this cell pinning the aggregate settles it; split, no reading = one position's seeds disagree with each other. The Layer 2 inflow over the rule's target in the tail: one-sided median 0.018594, -0.048873 to 0.075969; two-sided median -7.4e-05, -0.048873 to 0.001076. Carrier and gain cells by reading: split, no reading 2, the aggregate decides 58. Where the position decides: nowhere.
criteria.name: A31-3 the aggregate is pinned either way, so who is below the floor is the reading
